errors.text_span: 之后整体呈波动下降趋势
errors.evidence: The description claims the Rest14 line shows an 'overall fluctuating downward trend' after window size 3. However, the line fluctuates without a clear downward trend. It starts at ~86.7% at size 3 and ends at ~85.7% at size 10, but the start and end points of the entire line (size 1 and 10) are almost identical (~85.8%). Calling it a downward trend is a misleading over-generalization.

errors.evidence: The description states that the Twitter line fluctuates between 76% and 77.8%. However, the value at window size 10 is approximately 75.7%, which is below the stated lower bound of 76%.
